why_no_input_reaches_it: clamp of the scaled accumulator: the product of a 64 bit accumulator and a ratio of at most one never leaves the closed range of 2^63
remaining delta minus the closed amount: the closed amount has the delta's sign and no more magnitude, so the subtraction cannot overflow
size plus the closed amount: the closed amount has the opposite sign to the size and no more magnitude, so the sum cannot overflow
accumulator minus its share: the share has the accumulator's sign and no more magnitude, so the subtraction cannot overflow
size plus the closed amount on the negative arm: same opposite-sign argument as the positive arm
negating a closed amount of 2^63: needs a size and a delta of magnitude 2^63 with opposite signs, which no pair of i64 values has
